title: Dewdrop Plot
short: Plan clever water routes, grow a little harvest, and make every drop count.
strap: A small garden. A clever little drop.
cards: One tank, a clever little garden
Each crop bed needs a visible amount of water. Choose the harvest that matters and plan within the supply.
Draw the route, then watch it bloom
Sketch channels, set the gates, and release a single watering pulse through your plan. Undo, reset and retry freely.
Solve 60 plots, grow your experience, and chase unassisted three-star records. A daily challenge brings a fresh little goal.
